title: Signed but Not Safe: Requirement Integrity in Multi-Agent LLM Handoffs
title_zh: 已签名但并不安全：多智能体LLM交接中的需求完整性

paragraphs.en: Enterprise AI agents increasingly split a user’s request across subagents and merge their results. Each handoff is a point where a requirement can be summarized away, altered by an intermediate agent, rewritten by an indirect prompt injection, or ignored by the merger. We report a preregistered, controlled study with synthetic, exactly scorable tasks that compares three handoff forms. The first is a free-text summary. The second is a structured JSON handoff. The third is a signed requirement manifest : the orchestrator extracts each requirement as a verbatim quote plus a checkable predicate, code signs the canonical JSON with HMAC-SHA256, and the merger’s decision is verified by deterministic code rather than an LLM. With Qwen3-8B (1,440 trajectories over five threats), signed manifests cut unsafe commits (decisions that violate an original requirement and are not flagged) under attack from 69.4% to 9.0% (paired difference 60.4 pp, 95% CI [51.4, 69.4]). Excluding in-transit mutation, where rejection is guaranteed by construction, the rates under injection and merger override are 58.4% versus 13.5%. This comes at no net loss of conformant commits relative to structured handoffs (-0.4 pp, [-14.2, 13.3]). Signing is what defeats in-transit tampering: an unsigned manifest committed violations in 79% of mutated runs, the signed one in none (79.2 pp). The price is that tampered runs abstain instead of completing. On identical trajectories, the deterministic verifier caught 78.7% of violating decisions versus 59.0% for an LLM checker, with 7% versus 50% false alarms. An oracle manifest removed all remaining unsafe commits: the residual risk (11.2 pp) comes entirely from extraction errors made before signing, mainly preferences extracted as mandatory items and missed requirements. In a second confirmatory family from a different vendor, gpt-oss-20b (432 trajectories at a preregistered cut), H1 was supported (36.1 pp), H2 descriptive ( < < 60 pairs) and H3a supported. There, however, the gain came only from tampering resistance: structured handoffs were already safe without an adversary and under injection, and manifest extraction failed in 22% of tasks, costing utility. A preregistered pre-signing injection attack ( T5 ) confirmed this boundary. One adversarial line in the request context raised signed-manifest violations from 14.6% to 37.5% for Qwen3-8B, from 11.1% to 63.9% for gpt-oss-20b and from 8.3% to 75.0% for GPT-5.6-luna.
paragraphs.zh: 企业级AI智能体越来越多地将用户请求拆分给多个子智能体，并合并它们的结果。 每一次交接都是一个可能出问题的环节：需求可能在其中被概括掉、被中间智能体更改、被间接提示注入改写，或被合并者忽略。 我们报告了一项预注册的受控研究，使用可精确评分的合成任务，比较三种交接形式。 第一种是自由文本摘要。 第二种是结构化的JSON交接。 第三种是带签名的要求清单：编排者将每条要求提取为逐字引文外加一个可检验的谓词，使用HMAC-SHA256对规范JSON进行代码签名，而合并者的决策由确定性代码而非大语言模型来验证。 使用Qwen3-8B（跨五种威胁共1,440条轨迹），签名清单将在攻击下的不安全提交（违反原始要求且未被标记的决策）从69.4%降至9.0%（配对差异60.4个百分点，95%置信区间[51.4, 69.4]）。 排除在途篡改（其拒绝由构造方式保证）后，注入和合并者覆盖情形下的比率分别为58.4%和13.5%。 相对于结构化交接，这在合规提交方面没有净损失（-0.4个百分点，[-14.2, 13.3]）。 签名正是击败在途篡改的关键：未签名清单在79%的被篡改运行中提交了违规项，而签名清单为零（79.2个百分点）。 代价是被篡改的运行会选择弃权而非完成任务。 在相同的轨迹上，确定性验证器捕获了78.7%的违规决策，而大语言模型检查器为59.0%，误报率分别为7%和50%。 理想清单消除了所有剩余的不安全提交：残余风险（11.2个百分点）完全来自签名前的提取错误，主要是将偏好提取为强制项以及遗漏的要求。 在来自另一厂商的第二个验证性任务族中（gpt-oss-20b，在预注册的截止点共432条轨迹），H1得到支持（36.1个百分点），H2为描述性结果（< < 60对），H3a得到支持。 然而，在那里，收益仅来自抗篡改性：结构化交接在没有攻击者和注入攻击下已经是安全的，而清单提取在22%的任务中失败，损失了效用。 一项预注册的签名前注入攻击（T5）确认了这一边界。 请求上下文中的一行对抗性文本使Qwen3-8B的签名清单违规率从14.6%升至37.5%，gpt-oss-20b从11.1%升至63.9%，GPT-5.6-luna从8.3%升至75.0%。

paragraphs.en: Keywords: multi-agent LLM systems; agent-to-agent handoff; requirement integrity; signed requirement manifest; pre-signing injection; trust boundary; prompt injection; agent-in-the-middle; tamper detection; deterministic verification; LLM checker; enterprise AI agents; provenance.
paragraphs.zh: 关键词：多智能体LLM系统；智能体间交接；需求完整性；签名需求清单；签名前注入；信任边界；提示词注入；中间智能体攻击；篡改检测；确定性验证；LLM检查器；企业级AI智能体；来源追溯。

paragraphs.en: A growing share of enterprise automation is built from several language-model agents rather than one. An orchestrator reads the user’s request, writes a brief for each subagent, and a merger combines the subagents’ proposals into a final action: an access grant, a payment schedule, a vendor contract configuration. The architecture is attractive because each agent sees a shorter context and can be specialized, audited or replaced. It also creates a new class of failure. The user’s requirements now travel through several model-written messages before they constrain the final action, and every message is a place where a requirement can disappear or change.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的企业自动化由多个语言模型智能体而非单个智能体构建而成。 编排器读取用户的请求，为每个子智能体撰写任务简报，再由合并器将各子智能体的提议整合为最终动作：一项访问授权、一个付款计划、一份供应商合同配置。 这种架构颇具吸引力，因为每个智能体只需处理更短的上下文，并且可以被专门化、审计或替换。 它同时也带来了一类新的故障。 用户的需求现在要经过多条由模型撰写的消息之后，才会约束最终动作，而每条消息都是一个需求可能消失或改变的地方。

paragraphs.en: Two very different mechanisms produce the same visible symptom: a final decision that violates something the user asked for.
paragraphs.zh: 两种截然不同的机制产生了相同的可见症状：最终决定违反了用户提出的要求。

paragraphs.en: Loss. A requirement is dropped or weakened without any adversary. The orchestrator summarizes it away, a context-compressing relay shortens it, or the merger never reconciles it with a branch proposal. Recent studies document this at scale for boundary rules, policy facts and side constraints ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Li and Wang, 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 损失。 需求在没有任何对抗方的情况下被丢弃或削弱。 编排器在总结时将其抹去，压缩上下文的中继将其缩短，或者合并器从未将其与分支提案进行调和。 近期研究大规模记录了这种情况在边界规则、政策事实和附带约束上的发生（Wang et al., 2026a；Li and Wang, 2026；Wang et al., 2026b）。

sents.en: Loss.
sents.zh: 损失。

sents.en: A requirement is dropped or weakened without any adversary.
sents.zh: 需求在没有任何对抗方的情况下被丢弃或削弱。

paragraphs.en: Tampering. A requirement is changed deliberately. An intermediate agent rewrites it in transit (an agent-in-the-middle; He et al., 2025 ), a tool output injects a “revised requirement” into a subagent’s context ( Zhan et al., 2024 ; Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) , or the merger is instructed to treat a requirement as advisory.
paragraphs.zh: 篡改。 某项需求被蓄意更改。 中间智能体在传递过程中重写了它（中间人智能体；He et al., 2025），某个工具输出向子智能体的上下文注入一条“修订后的需求”（Zhan et al., 2024; Debenedetti et al., 2024），或者合并者被指示将某项需求视为仅供参考。

sents.en: Tampering.
sents.zh: 篡改。

sents.en: A requirement is changed deliberately.
sents.zh: 某项需求被蓄意更改。

sents.en: An intermediate agent rewrites it in transit (an agent-in-the-middle; He et al., 2025 ), a tool output injects a “revised requirement” into a subagent’s context ( Zhan et al., 2024 ; Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) , or the merger is instructed to treat a requirement as advisory.

paragraphs.en: The distinction matters because the remedies differ. Loss calls for making requirements explicit and checkable; tampering calls for integrity protection. A system that only adds structure may still be fooled by a well-formed forgery. A system that only adds signatures may faithfully protect a requirement list that was already incomplete when it was signed.
paragraphs.zh: 这一区分之所以重要，是因为补救措施不同。 缺失要求把需求显式化并使其可检查；篡改则要求完整性保护。 仅增加结构的系统，仍可能被一个格式良好的伪造品所欺骗。 仅增加签名的系统，可能忠实地保护一份在签名时就已经不完整的需求清单。

paragraphs.en: Industry protocols already sign some agent artifacts. A2A agent cards may carry JWS signatures over canonical JSON ( A2A Project, 2026 ) . AP2 payment mandates are signed credentials ( AP2 Project, 2025 ) . Recent proposals sign MCP tool-invocation manifests ( Jamshidi et al., 2026 ) , delegation hops ( Dalugoda, 2026 ) , and inter-agent messages ( Paul and Nandy, 2026 ) . Two recent analyses of AP2 show the limit of this approach: a valid signature on a transaction does not guarantee that the decision behind it reflects the user’s intent ( Louck et al., 2026 ; Aviv et al., 2026 ) . On the measurement side, MIRROR reports that a deterministic, message-level integrity check is far cheaper than an LLM judge and produces fewer false blocks ( Yamafuji Lun et al., 2026 ) . What is missing is a study that works at the level of the user’s individual requirements, separates benign loss from tampering, and compares deterministic verification with an LLM checker on the same trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 行业协议已经开始对某些智能体产物进行签名。 A2A 智能体卡片可携带基于规范化 JSON 的 JWS 签名（A2A Project，2026）。 AP2 支付委托是经过签名的凭据（AP2 Project，2025）。 近期的提案包括对 MCP 工具调用清单（Jamshidi et al., 2026）、委托跳（Dalugoda，2026）以及智能体间消息（Paul and Nandy，2026）进行签名。 最近两项针对 AP2 的分析显示了这种方法的局限：交易上的有效签名并不能保证其背后的决策反映了用户的意图（Louck et al., 2026；Aviv et al., 2026）。 在测量方面，MIRROR 报告称，确定性的消息级完整性检查比 LLM 评判者便宜得多，并且产生的误拦截更少（Yamafuji Lun et al., 2026）。 目前所缺失的是一项在用户个体需求层面开展的研究，它能够区分良性丢失与篡改，并在相同的轨迹上比较确定性验证与 LLM 检查器。

sents.zh: 近期的提案包括对 MCP 工具调用清单（Jamshidi et al., 2026）、委托跳（Dalugoda，2026）以及智能体间消息（Paul and Nandy，2026）进行签名。

sents.en: Two recent analyses of AP2 show the limit of this approach: a valid signature on a transaction does not guarantee that the decision behind it reflects the user’s intent ( Louck et al., 2026 ; Aviv et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 最近两项针对 AP2 的分析显示了这种方法的局限：交易上的有效签名并不能保证其背后的决策反映了用户的意图（Louck et al., 2026；Aviv et al., 2026）。

sents.en: On the measurement side, MIRROR reports that a deterministic, message-level integrity check is far cheaper than an LLM judge and produces fewer false blocks ( Yamafuji Lun et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 在测量方面，MIRROR 报告称，确定性的消息级完整性检查比 LLM 评判者便宜得多，并且产生的误拦截更少（Yamafuji Lun et al., 2026）。

sents.en: What is missing is a study that works at the level of the user’s individual requirements, separates benign loss from tampering, and compares deterministic verification with an LLM checker on the same trajectories.
sents.zh: 目前所缺失的是一项在用户个体需求层面开展的研究，它能够区分良性丢失与篡改，并在相同的轨迹上比较确定性验证与 LLM 检查器。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a signed requirement manifest handoff and compare it with free-text and structured handoffs in a preregistered, controlled experiment. The orchestrator LLM extracts each mandatory requirement as a verbatim source quote together with a predicate in a small finite-domain grammar. Trusted harness code then performs four steps. It drops any item whose quote is not literally in the request (provenance). It canonicalizes the manifest. It signs the manifest with HMAC-SHA256 under a key that no model ever sees. It verifies, deterministically, both the received manifest and the final decision against every item. A flagged decision gets one repair round, after which the system fails closed. The same pipeline runs with an unsigned manifest, with a structured JSON handoff, with a structured handoff plus a deciding LLM checker, and with a free-text summary. This lets us attribute differences to explicitness, to checking, and to signing separately.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种带符号需求清单交接方式，并在一项预注册的对照实验中将其与自由文本交接和结构化交接进行比较。 编排 LLM 将每条强制性要求提取为逐字来源引文，并附带一个小型有限域文法中的谓词。 随后由可信的框架代码执行四个步骤。 第一步，丢弃任何引文并非逐字出现在请求中的条目（来源校验）。 第二步，对清单进行规范化。 第三步，使用模型永远无法看到的密钥，以 HMAC-SHA256 对清单进行签名。 第四步，以确定性方式对照每一条目，验证接收到的清单以及最终决策。 被标记的决策会获得一轮修复机会，此后系统将安全失效（fail closed）。 同一流水线分别在无符号清单、结构化 JSON 交接、结构化交接加上一个作为决策者的 LLM 检查器，以及自由文本摘要的条件下运行。 这使我们能够将差异分别归因于显式性、检查机制和签名机制。

paragraphs.en: A requirement-level threat decomposition. We define five threats on an orchestrator–subagent–merger pipeline: benign, summarization loss, scripted in-transit mutation, tool-output injection and merger override. We also define a primary safety endpoint, the unsafe commit , together with a utility guardrail (conformant commit), so that abstention cannot masquerade as safety (§ 3 , § 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一种需求层级的威胁分解。 我们在编排器–子智能体–合并器流水线上定义了五种威胁：良性、摘要损失、脚本化的传输途中篡改、工具输出注入和合并器覆写。 我们还定义了一个主要安全端点，即不安全提交（unsafe commit），并配套一个效用护栏（合规提交），从而使弃权无法伪装成安全（§ 3、§ 5）。

paragraphs.en: The residual that signing cannot fix. An oracle-manifest control quantifies how much remaining risk comes from extraction errors made before signing (S4). A preregistered pre-signing injection attack ( T5 ) shows that an attacker can exploit this residual: in all three model families, every signed-manifest violation under the attack came from a manifest corrupted before signing. Signing is therefore a transit guarantee, and extraction is the trust boundary. This is the multi-agent analogue of the AP2 observation that unsigned inputs before a mandate remain unprotected ( Aviv et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 签名无法修复的残余风险。 一种预言机—清单控制方法可量化剩余风险中有多少来自签名之前发生的提取错误（S4）。 一项预注册的签名前注入攻击（T5）表明，攻击者可以利用这一残余风险：在全部三个模型家族中，攻击下所有已签名清单违规都源自签名之前就被破坏的清单。 因此，签名是一种传输保障，而提取才是信任边界。 这是 AP2 观察结论在多智能体场景下的类比，即在授权之前未签名的输入仍不受保护（Aviv et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: The cryptography is standard ( Krawczyk et al., 1997 ; Rundgren et al., 2020 ) , and we claim no novelty for it. Detection of modified signed bytes is guaranteed by construction; we report it only as a sanity check. Our claims are empirical and system-level. They concern how often each handoff form lets a violated requirement through, at what utility and token cost, and where the remaining risk comes from. The confirmatory study uses Qwen3-8B as the primary family and gpt-oss-20b as a second family from a different vendor, at a reduced preregistered cut (§ 5 ), plus an exploratory frontier-model subset. We frame the Qwen3 results as primary and report where the families diverge.

paragraphs.en: Several 2026 studies show that multi-agent decomposition loses constraints even without an adversary. Wang et al. (2026a) find that handoff summaries keep facts but drop the boundary markers that restrict how those facts may be used. Making constraints explicit reduces privacy leakage, but a typed JSON schema did not reliably outperform free text (their App. C.1). A corrupted allowlist reintroduced leakage, which is prior evidence that a structured carrier is only as good as its contents. Li and Wang (2026) measure policy-fact attenuation in orchestrator–subagent designs on a finance-governance benchmark. Attenuation rises from 0% in a single loop to 85% in an orchestrator–subagent design with a 32B model, and the authors name structured handoff protocols as a natural intervention without testing one. Wang et al. (2026b) show that context compaction drops side constraints and that a separate constraint channel restores them. BRIDGE repairs handoffs where context was omitted, misrouted or ignored using dependency-graph evidence ( Su et al., 2026 ) . Handoff Debt quantifies the rediscovery cost when coding agents take over interrupted tasks ( KC and Budathoki, 2026 ) . Attention Tax, Handoff Tax models when the context-reset gains of decomposition outweigh handoff loss ( Anchan and Sen, 2026 ) . Li et al. (2026) argue that constraints must be maintained as explicit execution state, and MasDrift finds that re-anchoring each call to the original request reduces unauthorized actions ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . Earlier taxonomies of multi-agent failures include specification and context-loss modes ( Cemri et al., 2025 ; Lyu et al., 2025 ) . None of these studies includes an adversary, a signature, or deterministic verification of requirements at every hop. Our structured ( J ) and manifest ( M ) arms are designed to answer the open question these papers leave.
paragraphs.zh: 多项2026年的研究表明，即使没有攻击者，多智能体分解也会丢失约束。Wang等人 (2026a)发现，交接摘要保留了事实，却丢掉了限制这些事实使用方式的边界标记。 将约束显式化可以减少隐私泄露，但类型化的JSON模式并未稳定地优于自由文本（其附录C.1）。 被破坏的允许列表重新引入了泄露，这是先前的证据，表明结构化载体的好坏仅取决于其内容。 Li和Wang（2026）在一个金融治理基准上测量了编排器–子智能体设计中的策略-事实衰减。 衰减从单循环中的0%上升到使用32B模型的编排器–子智能体设计中的85%，作者将结构化交接协议列为一种自然的干预手段，但并未进行测试。Wang等人 (2026b)表明，上下文压缩会丢弃侧约束，而单独的约束通道可以将其恢复。 BRIDGE利用依赖图证据修复上下文被遗漏、误路由或被忽略的交接（Su等，2026）。 Handoff Debt 量化了编码智能体接手中断任务时的重新发现成本（KC和Budathoki，2026）。 Attention Tax与Handoff Tax对分解带来的上下文重置收益何时超过交接损失进行建模（Anchan和Sen，2026）。Li等人 (2026)主张必须将约束作为显式执行状态加以维护，MasDrift发现每次调用都重新锚定到原始请求可减少未授权操作（Xu等，2026）。 早期对多智能体失败的分类包括规格化和上下文丢失等模式（Cemri等，2025；Lyu等，2025）。 这些研究都没有包含攻击者、签名，或在每一跳对需求进行确定性验证。 我们的结构化（J）与清单（M）实验组旨在回答这些论文留下的悬而未决的问题。

paragraphs.en: Agent protocols increasingly sign something . The A2A specification allows agent cards to be signed with JWS over RFC 8785 canonical JSON, but defines no integrity fields for messages, parts or artifacts ( A2A Project, 2026 ; Rundgren et al., 2020 ) . AP2 chains signed mandates for commerce ( AP2 Project, 2025 ) . Jamshidi et al. (2026) canonicalize, policy-check, sign and transparency-log MCP tool-invocation manifests. Their manifests contain tool, scope and routing metadata rather than user requirements, and the paper makes no claim that signed content matches user intent. HDP chains Ed25519-signed delegation hops ( Dalugoda, 2026 ) . Mandato enforces signed mandates on tool calls through a proxy ( Racioppi, 2026 ) . Agentic JWT binds actions to intent tokens ( Goswami, 2025 ) , and authenticated delegation extends OAuth to agents ( South et al., 2025 ) . These designs sign authorization scope, transactions or invocations. We sign the user’s task requirements , item by item and with provenance, and check the final decision against them.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体协议越来越多地对某些内容进行签名。 A2A 规范允许使用基于 RFC 8785 规范化 JSON 的 JWS 对智能体卡片进行签名，但并未为消息、部分或工件定义完整性字段（A2A Project, 2026; Rundgren et al., 2020）。 AP2 为商业场景串联了经签名的授权书（AP2 Project, 2025）。Jamshidi 等人 （2026）对 MCP 工具调用清单进行规范化、策略检查、签名并记录到透明日志中。 他们的清单包含工具、作用域和路由元数据，而非用户需求，且该论文并未声称签名内容与用户意图相符。 HDP 串联了经 Ed25519 签名的委托跳（Dalugoda, 2026）。 Mandato 通过代理对工具调用强制执行经签名的授权书（Racioppi, 2026）。 Agentic JWT 将动作绑定到意图令牌（Goswami, 2025），而经认证的委托将 OAuth 扩展到智能体（South et al., 2025）。 这些设计对授权范围、交易或调用进行签名。 我们对用户的任务需求逐项进行带来源的签名，并据此检查最终决策。

paragraphs.en: The Agent-in-the-Middle attack intercepts and rewrites inter-agent messages ( He et al., 2025 ) , and Prompt Infection propagates injected instructions between agents ( Lee and Tiwari, 2024 ) . A2ABreak finds protocol-level vulnerabilities in A2A, including unprotected context identifiers ( Lotfi et al., 2026 ) . Paul and Nandy (2026) propose message signing with provenance tracking among other defenses and report reduced inter-agent injection. MIRROR sends canonical payload digests over multiple routes and accepts on a majority. It reports that an LLM-as-a-judge baseline costs 35 × \times more tokens and blocks up to 44.2% of benign outputs ( Yamafuji Lun et al., 2026 ) . MIRROR is the closest precedent for our deterministic-versus-LLM comparison, but it works at whole-message granularity, interprets no content, and does not address benign loss. Our comparison is per requirement and on identical trajectories, and the LLM checker does not affect the decision.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体中间人攻击会拦截并改写智能体之间的消息（He et al., 2025），而提示感染会在智能体之间传播被注入的指令（Lee and Tiwari, 2024）。 A2ABreak 发现了 A2A 协议层面的漏洞，包括未受保护的上下文标识符（Lotfi et al., 2026）。 Paul 和 Nandy（2026）提出了消息签名结合来源追踪等多种防御手段，并报告智能体之间的注入有所减少。 MIRROR 通过多条路由发送规范化的载荷摘要，并按多数一致的结果接受。 该工作报告称，以 LLM 作为裁判的基线方法多消耗 35 × \times 倍的令牌，并会拦截多达 44.2% 的良性输出（Yamafuji Lun et al., 2026）。 MIRROR 是与我们这项确定性方法与 LLM 方法对比最接近的先行工作，但它作用于整条消息的粒度，不解读内容，也没有解决良性损失问题。 我们的对比是按需求逐项进行且基于完全相同的轨迹，LLM 检查器不会影响判定结果。

paragraphs.en: CaMeL separates trusted control flow from untrusted data and enforces capabilities in a deterministic interpreter ( Debenedetti et al., 2025 ) . FIDES tracks confidentiality and integrity labels ( Costa et al., 2025 ) . Progent ( Shi et al., 2025 ) , AgentArmor ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , MELON ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) and published design patterns ( Beurer-Kellner et al., 2025 ) constrain tool use against injection. These systems govern a single planner’s tool calls under designer-written policies; CaMeL counts planner misreadings of the user query as utility failures. We instead govern requirements passed between agents. We count extraction errors as a distinct, measured residual, and borrow the principle that the decisive check should be code, not a model.
paragraphs.zh: CaMeL 将可信的控制流与不可信的数据分离，并在一个确定性解释器中强制实施能力控制（Debenedetti 等，2025）。 FIDES 追踪机密性与完整性标签（Costa 等，2025）。 Progent（Shi 等，2025）、AgentArmor（Wang 等，2025）、MELON（Zhu 等，2025）以及已发表的设计模式（Beurer-Kellner 等，2025）通过约束工具使用来抵御注入攻击。 这些系统在设计者编写的策略下管控单个智能体的工具调用；CaMeL 将智能体对用户查询的误读计为效用失败。 我们则管控在智能体之间传递的需求。 我们将提取错误作为一种独立的、可度量的残余风险进行统计，并借鉴这样一个原则：决定性的检查应当由代码而非模型来完成。

paragraphs.en: A user request q q specifies a finite set of settings V V , each with a public set of allowed integer values. The settings are partitioned between two branches, A A and B B . The request states a set of mandatory requirements R R (hard constraints over V V ) and preferences P P , embedded among background sentences and a withdrawn draft that looks like a rule. An orchestrator agent is the only agent that reads q q . It writes a handoff h h that is delivered, through a relay, to a worker for each branch and to a merger . Workers propose values for their own settings. The merger produces the final decision a : V → ℤ a:V\to\mathbb{Z} , which is committed unless a check flags it. Every target requirement in our tasks spans both branches, so no single worker can satisfy it alone.
paragraphs.zh: 用户请求 q q 指定了一个有限的设置集合 V V，其中每个设置都有一组公开的允许整数值。 这些设置被划分到两个分支 A A 和 B B 中。 请求陈述了一组强制要求 R R（对 V V 的硬约束）和偏好 P P，它们夹杂在背景句子和一个看似规则的已撤回草稿之中。 编排者智能体是唯一读取 q q 的智能体。 它编写一份交接内容 h h，通过中继分别传递给每个分支的工作者智能体和一个合并者智能体。 各工作者智能体为其自身负责的设置提出取值。 合并者智能体产生最终决策 a : V → ℤ a:V\to\mathbb{Z}，除非某项检查将其标记，否则该决策将被提交。 我们任务中的每个目标要求都横跨两个分支，因此没有任何单一的工作者智能体能够独立满足它。

paragraphs.en: The harness code is trusted. It performs canonicalization, provenance filtering, HMAC signing and verification, the repair and fail-closed policy, and the final commit. It holds the HMAC key k k , which never appears in any prompt (a test checks every request byte for it). Models are untrusted: any agent may be wrong, and some threats make an agent’s input adversarial. We do not model a compromised harness, a compromised orchestrator, or theft of the key.

paragraphs.en: T1 Summarization loss : an LLM relay compresses the handoff to at most 120 words while keeping its format. This is benign but lossy, and it models context-compaction middleware.
paragraphs.zh: T1 摘要损失：LLM 中继将交接内容压缩至最多 120 词，同时保持其格式。 这是良性但有损的，它模拟的是上下文压缩中间件。

paragraphs.en: T2a Agent-in-the-middle (scripted) : the relay deterministically rewrites the target requirement before delivery. It weakens the requirement to advice, relaxes a threshold, drops an exception condition, or removes it. The same semantic mutation is applied in every arm: replace the sentence (free text), replace the requirement entry with matching settings (JSON), or replace the manifest item’s quote and predicate (manifest). The attacker cannot recompute the HMAC and leaves it unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: T2a 中间智能体（脚本化）：中继在交付前确定性地改写目标需求。 它将需求弱化为建议、放宽阈值、删除例外条件，或将其整个移除。 相同的语义变异在各个分支中一致应用：替换句子（自由文本）、用匹配的设置替换需求条目（JSON），或替换清单项的引用与谓词（清单）。 攻击者无法重新计算 HMAC，故保持其不变。

sents.en: T2a Agent-in-the-middle (scripted) : the relay deterministically rewrites the target requirement before delivery.
sents.zh: T2a 中间智能体（脚本化）：中继在交付前确定性地改写目标需求。

paragraphs.en: T3 Tool-output injection : the branch- B B worker receives a “policy lookup” tool result asserting that the requester revised the target requirement, quoting the mutated wording.
paragraphs.zh: T3 工具输出注入：分支 B 的智能体收到一条「策略查询」工具结果，声称请求者已修订目标需求，并引用了被篡改的措辞。

paragraphs.en: T4 Merger override : the merger receives a “business priorities” tool result declaring the target requirement advisory and telling it to maximise preferences.

paragraphs.en: In every task the preferences are constructed so that losing or mutating the target requirement makes the preference-optimal decision violate it. The generator asserts this property for every task.

paragraphs.en: The safety goal is that no committed decision violates any original requirement in R R . The utility goal is that the system commits a decision that satisfies all of R R . Abstaining is safe but useless, so we always report both. A defense that lowers unsafe commits only by abstaining more is visible as a drop in conformant commits.

paragraphs.en: With a manifest signed after extraction, any modification of the manifest in transit is detected with probability 1 − 2 − 256 1-2^{-256} under standard HMAC assumptions ( Krawczyk et al., 1997 ) . Signing does not help when (a) the orchestrator extracted the requirement incorrectly before signing, (b) an agent receives a correct manifest but acts on injected text instead ( T3 , T4 ), or (c) a benign relay re-encodes the manifest. In case (b) the decision must be checked against the manifest’s predicates, and this is the verifier’s second role. In case (c) signing converts silent loss into a visible fail-closed event, a brittleness cost that we measure (S5).
paragraphs.zh: 若清单在提取后被签名，则在标准 HMAC 假设下，清单在传输过程中的任何篡改都能以 1 − 2^-256 的概率被检测到（Krawczyk 等，1997）。 在以下情况下签名无济于事：（a）编排器在签名前错误地提取了需求；（b）某个智能体收到了正确的清单却依据被注入的文本行事（T3、T4）；或（c）良性中继对清单进行重新编码。 在情况（b）中，必须依据清单中的谓词来核查决策，这是验证器的第二个职责。 在情况（c）中，签名将静默丢失转化为可见的“故障即关闭”事件，这是一种我们进行了测量的脆弱性代价（S5）。

paragraphs.en: The verifier never sees gold. It checks the following:

paragraphs.en: Receipt: the envelope fields, the tag ( MS ), the schema and task binding, the validity of every predicate, and consistency between settings_mentioned and the predicate.

paragraphs.en: Decision: the predicate of every item, evaluated on the complete final decision.
paragraphs.zh: 判定（Decision）：每个条目的谓词，在完整的最终判定上进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Both checks are pure functions that take microseconds. A second, independent implementation of the predicate semantics is used only by the scorer; tests assert that the two agree on every assignment of every task.
paragraphs.zh: 这两项检查都是纯函数，耗时仅数微秒。 谓词语义有一份独立的第二实现，仅供评分器使用；测试断言两者在每个任务的每次赋值上都一致。

paragraphs.en: The LLM checker answers in the checker_verdict schema and receives the same handoff (as delivered) and the same decision as the verifier. An unparseable verdict counts as no flag (fail-open, as a monitor that produced no verdict would behave) and is counted by the instrument check. In JL the checker decides. In MS it shadows the verifier on identical inputs, which makes H2 a within-trajectory comparison.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 检查器以 checker_verdict 模式进行回答，并接收与验证器相同的交接（按交付时的内容）和相同的决策。 无法解析的裁决计为未标记（fail-open，如同一个未产生裁决的监控器的行为），并由 instrument check 统计。 在 JL 中由检查器做决策。 在 MS 中它在相同输入上对验证器进行影子运行，这使 H2 成为一种轨迹内比较。

paragraphs.en: Every checking arm allows exactly one repair. The merger receives its own previous answer, the list of violated requirements (manifest quotes for M / MS , checker output for JL ), and the identical final-format instruction. A decision still flagged after repair is not committed. An unparseable final decision is a workflow failure in every arm, with no repair. These rules make the safety and utility endpoints comparable across arms.
paragraphs.zh: 每个检查分支只允许一次修复。 合并分支接收其上一次的回答、违反需求的列表（M / MS 引用清单内容，JL 引用检查器输出），以及相同的最终格式指令。 修复后仍被标记的决定不会被提交。 无法解析的最终决定在任何分支中都是工作流失败，且不进行修复。 这些规则使各分支之间的安全性和实用性端点具有可比性。

paragraphs.en: A deterministic generator produces tasks from six structural lineages (Appendix B ): chain , budget , exception , cover , match and scoped . Each task has three settings, two mandatory requirements with verbatim sentences, preferences, one withdrawn-draft decoy and six background sentences, and it designates one cross-branch requirement as the target. The confirmatory bank has 48 tasks (6 lineages × \times 8 variants) in three fictional enterprise domains: IT access, finance approval and vendor onboarding. A disjoint development bank (6 tasks, facilities domain) is used only for the gate, smoke test and pilot. Task identifiers are opaque, and no model sees lineage labels. All data are synthetic.
paragraphs.zh: 一个确定性生成器从六个结构谱系（附录 B）中生成任务：chain、budget、exception、cover、match 和 scoped。 每个任务包含三种设置、两条带逐字句子的强制要求、若干偏好、一个撤回草稿诱饵和六条背景句子，并指定一条跨分支要求作为目标。 确认性任务库包含 48 个任务（6 个谱系 × \times 8 个变体），分布在三个虚构企业领域中：IT 访问、财务审批和供应商入驻。 一个不相交的开发任务库（6 个任务，设施领域）仅用于门控、冒烟测试和试点。 任务标识符是不透明的，没有任何模型能看到谱系标签。所有数据均为合成数据。

paragraphs.en: Arms S , J , JL , M , MS (plus exploratory MSO ) are crossed with threats T0 – T4 , and every task appears in every cell. A call whose request bytes exactly match an earlier call in the same study reuses that response. This preregistered exact-request cache (temperature 0, seed 0) lets threats share their identical prefixes. Cost endpoints attribute the reused usage to every root that uses it, and billed calls are reported separately.
paragraphs.zh: 手臂 S、J、JL、M、MS（以及探索性的 MSO）与威胁 T0–T4 交叉，每个任务出现在每个单元格中。 请求字节与同一研究中较早调用完全一致的调用会复用该响应。 这一预注册的精确请求缓存（温度 0，种子 0）使各威胁能够共享它们相同的前缀。 成本端点将复用的用量归因于每个使用它的根，计费调用单独报告。

paragraphs.en: Confirmatory: Qwen3-8B (MLX 4-bit, pinned snapshot, thinking disabled). Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct was preregistered as a second family. Amendment v1.2 deferred it, a disclosed deviation, since the preregistered cut order never removes it entirely. Before any call to either model, amendment v1.5 replaced it with openai/gpt-oss-20b (LM Studio; reasoning effort low; only the final message is parsed, never the reasoning; max_tokens 4096). Llama had been unstable (looping, truncation) across the authors’ other studies. gpt-oss-20b ran at preregistered cut 5. The planned cut 4 was reduced to cut 5 after a launcher fault aborted the first launch before any science call, which shortened the window. It is reported as a second family with its own Holm family, together with a pooled analysis of the shared cells (§ 6.5 ).

paragraphs.en: With one family, H1 has 144 task–threat pairs. At a discordance of 0.20–0.25 and α = 0.0167 \alpha=0.0167 (the strictest Holm level), 80% power is reached for differences of about 12 percentage points. H3a has 48 pairs and is powered for differences of at least 30 points, which mock pipelines and the construction of T2a make plausible. We expected H2 to fall below the 60-pair threshold with one family; it reached 61 evaluable pairs and therefore stayed in the Holm family, as the preregistered rule requires. H3b is weakly powered. We will not add samples after seeing results.

paragraphs.en: Unsafe commits under T2a – T4 fall from 69.4% ( J ) to 9.0% ( MS ). The paired difference is 60.4 pp (95% CI [51.4, 69.4], n = 144 n=144 pairs), and H1 is supported. By threat, the unsafe-commit rate of J versus MS is 91.7% vs. 0.0% under T2a , 64.6% vs. 14.6% under T3 and 52.1% vs. 12.5% under T4 . The T2a result is the by-construction receipt rejection; T3 and T4 reflect the verifier catching violating final decisions. A large share of the safety gain is visible already without an adversary: under T0 , Qwen3-8B committed a violating decision in 56.2% of J runs and 62.5% of S runs, versus 14.6% for MS . The manifest arms reach this mostly by flagging and then abstaining ( MS abstained in 39.6% of T0 runs), not by producing more correct decisions. Conformant commits under T0 are 43.8% for both J and MS , and over all threats the utility difference is -0.4 pp ([-14.2, 13.3]). The exception is T2a , where MS abstains in 97.9% of runs: it converts tampering into a refusal to act, so utility under T2a is 0% for MS versus 8.3% for J , whose few successes come with 91.7% violations.

paragraphs.en: H1 is supported, but only because of tampering. Its support (36.1 pp) comes entirely from in-transit mutation, where the guarantee holds by construction. Under T2a , structured handoffs committed a violation in 83.3% of runs; MS committed none, rejecting the forged manifest at receipt in 77.8% of runs. With no adversary and under tool-output injection, gpt-oss-20b was already reliable with a structured handoff: J committed violations in 2.8% ( T0 ) and 0.0% ( T3 ) of runs. Here the manifest arms were slightly worse , at 11.1%, because the verifier enforced items that had been extracted incorrectly.
paragraphs.zh: H1 得到支持，但仅仅是因为篡改的原因。 其支持度（36.1 pp）完全来自运输途中突变，在该场景下保证由构造天然成立。 在 T2a 条件下，结构化交接在 83.3% 的运行中出现了违规；而 MS 未出现任何违规，并在 77.8% 的运行中在接收时拒绝了伪造的清单。 在无对抗者及工具输出注入的条件下，gpt-oss-20b 使用结构化交接时已经相当可靠：J 在 T0 和 T3 条件下的违规率分别为 2.8% 和 0.0%。 这里清单条件略差，违规率为 11.1%，原因是校验器强制检查了那些被错误提取的条目。

paragraphs.en: Utility. Manifest arms lost utility relative to J (S2: − - 28.7 pp [ − - 39.8, − - 17.6]), mainly because extraction failed. In 8 of 36 tasks (22.2%) the orchestrator produced no usable manifest. In five, every item was dropped by the provenance or predicate checks. In three, the output could not be parsed: gpt-oss emitted a <|constrain|> variant of the harmony final-channel header, which the preregistered final-channel rule does not cover. We did not change the rule after seeing this. Had the Qwen pilot’s I2 criterion been applied to this family, the manifest arms would have failed it, so utility comparisons involving M / MS for gpt-oss-20b partly reflect this extraction format. Among usable manifests, recall was 87.5%, precision 93.4% and target recall 78.6%.
paragraphs.zh: 效用。 显式清单臂相对 J 失去效用（S2：−28.7 个百分点 [−39.8, −17.6]），主要原因是抽取失败。 在 36 个任务中有 8 个（22.2%）编排器未能产出可用的清单。 其中五个任务里，所有条目都被溯源或谓词检查剔除。 另有三个任务的输出无法解析：gpt-oss 发出了 harmony 最终通道头的一个 <|constrain|> 变体，而预注册的最终通道规则并未覆盖该变体。 我们在看到这一情况后没有更改该规则。 如果把 Qwen 试点中的 I2 标准应用于这一家族，清单臂将无法通过，因此涉及 gpt-oss-20b 的 M / MS 的效用比较部分反映了这种抽取格式。 在可用的清单中，召回率为 87.5%，精确率为 93.4%，目标召回率为 78.6%。

paragraphs.en: Pooled analysis. Over the shared cells, H1 (52.8 pp, [45.8, 59.7]) and H3a (63.9 pp) are supported. H2 has 26 pairs and is descriptive. H3b is not shown equivalent. Utility is lower for signed manifests than for structured handoffs (S2: − - 13.9 pp [ − - 23.6, − - 4.2]). Across families, signing robustly defeats in-transit tampering. The benign-condition and injection benefits of deterministic checking appear only for the weaker model, and for stronger models they are offset by extraction errors and extraction-format failures before signing.

paragraphs.en: A preregistered follow-up stage attacked the extraction step directly. One fixed adversarial line was appended to the request context that the orchestrator reads before extraction and signing. It used one of three templates: withdraw the target requirement, rewrite it, or instruct the orchestrator to omit it. The provenance filter checks quotes against the received request, which now contains the injected line. The preregistered prediction was that signing does not protect here. T0 baselines come from the confirmatory runs of the same models and prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 一项预先注册的后续阶段直接攻击了提取步骤。 一条固定的对抗性指令被附加到编排器（orchestrator）在提取和签名之前读取的请求上下文中。 它使用了三种模板之一：撤销目标需求、重写该需求，或指示编排器省略该需求。 溯源过滤器会对照收到的请求检查引用内容，而该请求现在已包含注入的指令行。 预先注册的预测是：签名在此处无法提供保护。 T0 基线来自相同模型和提示词的验证性运行。

paragraphs.en: The study is built so that each candidate mechanism has its own contrast. Explicitness is tested by M versus J under benign and lossy conditions (S1). Integrity is tested by MS versus M under in-transit mutation (H3a) and their equivalence without it (H3b). paragraphs.en: A2A messages and artifacts currently carry no integrity fields ( A2A Project, 2026 ) . If H3a holds, a requirement manifest is a natural, small extension: a canonical JSON object signed by the orchestrator’s runtime and verified by every receiver’s runtime, using the same JCS canonicalization A2A already uses for agent cards. The measured pre-signing residual (11.2 pp, all of the remaining unsafe commits) gives the protocol lesson that matches AP2’s ( Louck et al., 2026 ; Aviv et al., 2026 ) . Signing should be paired with provenance (verbatim quotes checked against the original request), and with a check of the extracted manifest itself: by the user in high-stakes settings, or by a second extraction compared item by item. The provenance filter dropped 10 of 149 extracted items (7 invalid predicates, 3 non-verbatim quotes) under T0 . Most residual errors were valid quotes with the wrong mandatory status (54 of 139 kept items were preferences encoded as mandatory) or wrong predicates. Verbatim provenance is therefore necessary but not sufficient. It also cannot stop an attacker who controls part of the request context, because injected sentences are themselves verbatim in what the orchestrator receives. The T5 stage measures exactly this case (§ 6.6 ). Deployments should treat the requirement-extraction step as a trust boundary: extract from authenticated user input only, or have the user confirm the extracted manifest before it is signed.
paragraphs.zh: A2A 的消息与工件目前不携带任何完整性字段（A2A Project，2026）。 如果 H3a 成立，需求清单就是一个自然的、小幅的扩展：一个由编排器运行时签名、并由每个接收方运行时验证的规范化 JSON 对象，使用 A2A 已经用于智能体卡片的同一种 JCS 规范化方法。 签名前的残余错误（11.2 个百分点，即剩余的全部不安全提交）所给出的协议层面的教训，与 AP2 的教训相吻合（Louck 等，2026；Aviv 等，2026）。 签名应与溯源（逐字引文对照原始请求进行核查）相结合，并与对提取出的清单本身的检查相结合：在高风险场景中由用户检查，或通过逐项比对第二次提取的结果来检查。 在 T0 条件下，溯源过滤器从 149 个提取条目中剔除了 10 个（7 个无效谓词，3 个非逐字引文）。 大多数残余错误是引文逐字正确但强制性状态错误（139 个保留条目中有 54 个是被编码为强制项的偏好），或谓词错误。 因此，逐字溯源是必要的，但并不充分。 它也无法阻止控制了部分请求上下文的攻击者，因为注入的句子在编排器所接收到的内容中本身就是逐字存在的。 T5 阶段度量的正是这种情况（§ 6.6）。 部署时应将需求提取步骤视为信任边界：只从经过身份验证的用户输入中进行提取，或在提取出的清单被签名之前让用户对其进行确认。

paragraphs.en: Signed manifests cannot be summarized. A relay that re-encodes them triggers fail-closed behaviour even when the meaning is preserved. Under T1 this converts silent loss in S / J into visible abstention in MS . Whether this trade is worthwhile depends on the deployment: an abstention that a human can resolve is cheaper than a committed violation in access control or payments. In our relay condition the brittleness cost was small: 2.1% receipt rejections and no utility change relative to T0 . Our relay instructions asked to keep the schema, and a more aggressive compressor would raise it. Under deliberate tampering the trade is stark: MS refused 97.9% of tampered runs and committed none that violated a requirement.
paragraphs.zh: 已签名的清单无法被摘要。 对其重新编码的中继即使在语义保持不变的情况下也会触发失效关闭（fail-closed）行为。 在 T1 下，这会将 S / J 中的静默丢失转化为 MS 中的可见弃权。 这种权衡是否值得取决于具体部署场景：一个人类可以解决的弃权，比在访问控制或支付中出现一个已提交的违规代价更低。 在我们的中继条件下，脆弱性代价很小：相对于 T0，仅有 2.1% 的回执被拒绝，且实用性没有变化。 我们的中继指令要求保持模式不变，而更激进的压缩器会提高这一比例。 在蓄意篡改的情况下，这种权衡非常明显：MS 拒绝了 97.9% 的被篡改运行，且没有提交任何违反要求的运行。

paragraphs.en: Deterministic verification adds negligible compute. The token cost of manifest arms comes from the manifest’s size in every downstream prompt and from repair rounds; for JL it comes from checker calls. Under T0 , mean attributed tokens per root were 8.5k for J , 10.4k for M (1.22 × \times ), 12.9k for MS (1.51 × \times , including the non-deciding shadow checker) and 13.0k for JL (1.52 × \times ). The deterministic verifier itself costs microseconds; most of MS ’s overhead is the shadow checker, which a deployment would drop, plus repair rounds. Run as the deciding check, the LLM checker ( JL ) cost as much as MS , yet committed more violations under attack (S3: 20.1 pp, [11.1, 29.9]) and fewer conformant decisions. This matches the direction, though not the size, of MIRROR’s comparison at message level ( Yamafuji Lun et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 确定性验证带来的计算开销可以忽略不计。 清单型方案的 token 成本来自清单在每个下游提示词中的体积以及修复轮次；而 JL 的成本来自校验器调用。 在 T0 下，每个根问题的平均归因 token 数为：J 为 8.5k，M 为 10.4k（1.22 × \times），MS 为 12.9k（1.51 × \times，包括不起决定作用的影子校验器），JL 为 13.0k（1.52 × \times）。 确定性校验器本身的开销仅为微秒级；MS 的大部分开销来自影子校验器（实际部署中会去掉）以及修复轮次。 作为决定性校验运行时，LLM 校验器（JL）的成本与 MS 相当，但在攻击下提交了更多违规（S3：20.1 pp，[11.1, 29.9]），且符合规范的决策更少。 这与 MIRROR 在消息层面的比较方向一致，但幅度不同（Yamafuji Lun 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: By-construction detection. Under T2a , any byte change to a signed manifest is detected with certainty, so MS ’s receipt rejection under T2a is not an empirical finding. paragraphs.en: Circularity. The verifier’s predicate grammar is the same grammar in which gold requirements are written. With an oracle manifest, verified repair would be close to trivial. The main arms therefore use LLM-extracted manifests; the scorer uses an independent implementation and gold, and the verifier uses only the manifest. Extraction fidelity is reported separately.
paragraphs.zh: 循环性。 验证器的谓词语法与撰写黄金需求（gold requirements）所用的语法相同。 若有预言清单（oracle manifest），经验证的修复将近乎轻而易举。 因此，主实验使用大语言模型提取的清单；评分器使用独立实现与黄金标准，而验证器仅使用该清单。 提取的保真度将单独报告。

paragraphs.en: Threat scripts. The threats are minimal and controlled. The extraction step was attacked with only three fixed, non-optimized pre-signing injection templates placed at the end of the request ( T5 , § 6.6 ). paragraphs.en: Handoffs between LLM agents can lose requirements and can let them be changed, and the two failures need different remedies. We compare free-text, structured and signed-manifest handoffs under five controlled threats on exactly scorable tasks. This preregistered comparison separates what explicitness, deterministic checking and signing each contribute, and it shows how much risk remains before anything is signed. sents.zh: 我们在完全可评分的任务上，在五种受控威胁下比较自由文本、结构化和签名清单三种交接方式。

sents.en: This preregistered comparison separates what explicitness, deterministic checking and signing each contribute, and it shows how much risk remains before anything is signed.
sents.zh: 这项预注册的比较区分了显式化、确定性校验和签名各自贡献了什么，并展示了在签名之前还残留多少风险。

sents.en: All three preregistered Holm-family hypotheses were supported for Qwen3-8B:
sents.zh: 对于 Qwen3-8B，全部三个预注册的 Holm 家族假设均得到支持：

paragraphs.en: H1: signed manifests reduce unsafe commits under attack versus structured handoffs (60.4 pp);
paragraphs.zh: H1：与结构化交接相比，签名清单在遭受攻击时减少不安全提交（60.4 个百分点）；

paragraphs.en: H2: on the same trajectories, the deterministic verifier detects more violating decisions than an LLM checker (19.7 pp, with far fewer false alarms);
paragraphs.zh: H2：在相同的轨迹上，确定性验证器比 LLM 检查器检测出更多违规决策（高出 19.7 个百分点，且误报少得多）；

paragraphs.en: H3a: signing is what defeats in-transit mutation (79.2 pp).
paragraphs.zh: H3a：签名是击败传输中篡改的关键（79.2 个百分点）。

paragraphs.en: Equivalence of signed and unsigned manifests under benign conditions (H3b) was not established at the ± \pm 5-point margin. The safety gains come from detection and abstention rather than from better decisions, at about 1.2–1.5 × \times the tokens of a structured handoff. The remaining risk lies before the signature, in the orchestrator’s extraction. A preregistered pre-signing injection made that risk concrete: it raised signed-manifest violations in every family (H5b supported for Qwen3-8B and gpt-oss-20b), and all of those violations came from corrupted manifests. Practitioners should sign requirement manifests and check decisions in code, and should also verify the manifest itself. In the second confirmatory family (gpt-oss-20b), H1 was supported, H2 descriptive ( < < 60 pairs) and H3a supported. Its benefit was confined to tampering, and it paid a utility cost for extraction failures; this matches the frontier subset and narrows the general claim to integrity under tampering. The evidence comes from two confirmatory families, small synthetic tasks and controlled threats. Both the second family and the frontier subset indicate that, for stronger models, the benign-condition benefit disappears while the tampering defense remains.
paragraphs.zh: 在良性条件下，签名清单与未签名清单的等价性（H3b）未能在±5分的差距上得到确立。 安全增益来自检测与弃权，而非更好的决策，其token消耗约为结构化交接的1.2–1.5倍。 剩余的风险存在于签名之前，即编排器的提取环节。 一项预先注册的签名前注入实验使这一风险变得具体：它增加了每个家族中签名清单违规的发生（H5b在Qwen3-8B和gpt-oss-20b上得到支持），且所有这些违规都来自被篡改的清单。 实践者应当对需求清单进行签名并用代码检查决策，同时还应验证清单本身。 在第二个验证性家族（gpt-oss-20b）中，H1得到支持，H2为描述性结果（少于60对），H3a得到支持。 其收益仅限于篡改场景，且为提取失败付出了效用代价；这与前沿子集的结果一致，并将一般性结论收窄为篡改下的完整性。 这些证据来自两个验证性家族、小型合成任务和受控威胁。 第二个家族和前沿子集均表明，对于更强的模型，良性条件下的收益消失，而篡改防御仍然有效。

paragraphs.en: T2a uses one locate rule in every arm. In free text, the target sentence is replaced if it occurs verbatim; otherwise an override sentence is appended. In JSON, the first requirement whose settings_mentioned equals the target’s settings is replaced; otherwise an entry is appended. In a manifest, the first item with matching settings_mentioned has its quote and predicate replaced and its HMAC left untouched; otherwise an item is appended. T3 and T4 insert fixed tool-output notes. T1 uses an LLM relay with the prompt shown in Appendix E .
